thread:
Maya: Big win 🎉 — FlowScale signed a 24-month Dedicated contract and will also list our integration in the AWS Marketplace next week. Huge props to the deals team and SEs. Key bullets: cost predictability with Dedicated, SLOs in the contract, and a co-marketing marketplace listing.
Liam: Amazing! They migrated from a self-hosted competitor, right? Any numbers on latency/cost improvements we promised?
Riya: Yup — we committed to ~30% token cost reduction via batching + prefix caching, and 40% p95 latency improvement on their 8k context finetune traffic (expected). I can paste the perf run later.
Carlos: Eng update: dedicated cluster for FlowScale is provisioned in us-west-2 and the canary rollout is scheduled tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Will run smoke tests and KV warmups before cutover.
Maya: @Riya please add the perf run summary to the case study doc. @Anika we'll need a one-pager and a short customer quote (they agreed to a non-sensitive quote).
Anika: On it. I'll draft the blog + customer quote. Maya, do we have legal approval for a logo and quote? tagging legal-bot.
legal-bot: Hi — FlowScale sent over the logo permission and a short reference blurb. I've uploaded the signed PDF to Vault (link: https://redwood.app/vault/flowscale-ref). No red flags.
Liam: Nice. I'll update the CRM and mark the renewal/expansion motion complete. Also pinging channel for anyone who wants to join the customer success kickoff tomorrow 11:30 PT.
Riya: I can join kickoff. Also note: we configured a fallback model policy to route to a smaller quantized variant during capacity spikes — reduces cost and keeps latency bounded.
Carlos: Thanks — I'll validate routing policies with traffic replay. Quick snippet of the roll config we used:
```
route_policy:
  - priority: LOW_COST
    model_variant: redwood-quant-ggml-8bit
  - priority: HIGH_SLO
    model_variant: redwood-8k-bert-rt
```
Maya: Marketing ask — can we get a short spotlight for the homepage and Marketplace tile? Anika to own.
Anika: Will draft Marketplace listing text. Proposed blurb: "FlowScale accelerates fraud detection with Redwood Dedicated — 40% lower latency, predictable throughput." I'll share the draft in #marketing-drafts.
Liam: Quick customer nugget — FlowScale said our migration guide was "surprisingly straightforward" and customer success did the heavy lifting. Shoutout to the onboarding squad.
Carlos: Shoutout to infra team too — autoscaling and prefix cache changes were deployed this morning. deploy-bot, did the canary go green?
deploy-bot: Canary deploy for flowscale/dedicated-cluster completed. All health checks passed. Logs: https://ci.redwood/integrations/flowscale/1234
Maya: Love this. Next steps: (1) finalize marketplace listing (Anika), (2) publish case study with perf numbers (Riya + Marketing), (3) run joint announcement with FlowScale on their channels (Liam). If anyone wants to help with the case study interview, DM me. :tada:
Liam: I'll coordinate the joint announcement and intro FlowScale's comms lead.
Riya: I'll drop perf graphs and the sample prompt set into the case doc by EOD.
Anika: Drafts inbound. Will target publishing date next Wednesday. :sparkles:
Maya: Thanks team — huge win for Partnerships & Platform. Let's celebrate Friday! :beers:
